rationale: State-coherence schema discipline observation (operator-flagged 2026-05-16): StateBus(extra=ignore default) silently drops attempted  kwargs from constructor calls. Verified in test_state_bus_regime_not_in_model_fields: passing regime=WARP_CRUISE as kwarg succeeds without error and the computed regime returns REST. This is CORRECT for backward-compat (legacy scenario YAMLs with  lines silently migrate to the right computed value), but it is a future-bug surface if operator-authored Phase 0.x scenarios set regime explicitly thinking they will override.
lesson: Deferred improvement: future-strict-mode flag on StateBus (model_config extra="forbid") that rejects unknown kwargs. Lands when (a) operator-authored scenarios start setting regime explicitly, OR (b) v0.129 finalizes the schema lock. Until then, silent-drop is the right call for migration smoothness. The roundtrip serialization test (test_state_bus_roundtrip_json) is the canary: it passes today because computed regime in dump → dropped on validate. Flipping to strict mode requires excluding computed fields from dump (or using  consistently). Worth a §15.7 methodology entry in v0.129 final per operator analysis.
